cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Use the Proper Title
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge your standing through a title, privilege, courtesy, or public sign of respect.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put 'Director Patel' in your barbecue introductions, please. Titles before surnames; keep the order consistent.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm using first names. Even for the owner.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then list a separate welcome by Director Patel. That belongs in the programme, not the casual introductions.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The owner's doing the welcome. You offered to serve burgers.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then write 'Burgers served by Director Patel.' Read that before opening the queue, please. I'd like the job title to arrive before the ketchup.

reason: Make programme and timing corrections carry the title pursuit, with burger assignment changing the exact announcement.
